newsitem.title: USA: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE BID $105, PASSED - PRIVATE.
newsitem.headline: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE BID $105, PASSED - PRIVATE.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle bids near midday Monday at $105.00 per cwt on a dressed basis were passed by owners asking $106.00, market sources there said.
The bulk of last week's cattle sold at $105.00 following light activity early in the week at $106.00.
"If we get a bid at $106.00, we'll basically move everything we've got," one source said.
Fed cattle prices were seen pressured this week by a large carryover of cattle not sold last week, sources said.
This week's showlist is about 93,000 head, up 9,000 from last week, one source estimated.
